关于

此工作流程使用LS网对输入图像执行艺术家分类。该工作流程本身并不是真正用于生成图像，因为它只是输出与给定输入图像最相关的艺术家标签。它也不是针对 3D 风格和现实图像，也不是真正针对“传统”艺术，它纯粹是针对动漫风格的图像。

它对于查找缺少元数据的图像的提示中最有可能使用的艺术家标签很有用，或者即使图像有提示，它仍然可以用于查看哪些艺术家标签可以在元数据缺乏的情况下产生类似的结果。

使用的输入图像：https://aibooru.online/posts/111018

（对于在 2025 年 10 月 19 日美国东部时间晚上 11:45 之前下载此内容的人，请注意：艺术家标签子图犯了一个错误，导致其以错误的顺序运行，现在应该没问题了。）

o.en:
About

This workflow usesLSNetto perform artist classification on an input image. This workflow is not really for generating images per se, as it will simply output artist tags that are the most well-associated with a given input image. It is also not intended for 3D styles and realistic images, nor is it really intended for "traditional" art, it is purely for anime-style images.

It can be useful for finding the most likely artist tag(s) used in a prompt for an image that lacks metadata, or even if the image has a prompt, it can still be useful for seeing which artist tag(s) could yield similar results if the metadata lacks them.

Input image used:https://aibooru.online/posts/111018

(quick note for people who downloaded this prior to 11:45PM EST on 10/19/2025: made a mistake with the artist tags subgraph that made it operate in the wrong order, should be fine now.)
